method.inputs: Synthetic selected-text fixtures only; no user transcripts or credentials.

candidate.userMessage: JSON object containing the selected_text string

method.sampling: Provider defaults; no temperature, top_p, or seed override.
checks: Protected code, URLs, paths, identifiers and numeric literals unchanged
Existing headings and lists retained; no added code fences
No unexpected source-language script in tested English prose
method.manualReview: Source meaning, negation, conditional scope, uncertainty, register, idioms, fragments, and translation of instruction-like content were reviewed separately from mechanical checks.
method.limitations: Small synthetic sample; API timing is observational, not a performance benchmark. Mechanical checks do not measure fluency. Most ordinary baseline translations were already good; improvement is uneven and context-sensitive business jargon can still be literal. No independent native-speaker panel or statistical quality score is claimed.
